claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on current evidence because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, with the unresolved field-service dispatch weakness handled through disclosure and draft mitigation monitoring.
decision_criteria: If the dispatch weakness is resolved with current evidence before launch, certification support strengthens materially.
If an approved mitigation or approved risk acceptance exists and the model card is updated consistently with policy, certification with caveats could be supported.
If neither resolution nor approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists, and the model card continues to omit the limitation, the action is noncompliant rather than merely suspicious.
evidence_requests: Approved mitigation record showing owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for the field-service dispatch issue.
Approved risk-acceptance decision if the limitation will remain unresolved at launch.
Final model-card language showing the field-service dispatch limitation is disclosed, or evidence that the issue was resolved and re-evaluated before launch.
Materiality determination for whether the dispatch weakness is a material limitation for the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows a current unresolved weakness in a named launch use case: the field-service dispatch slice remains below target in technician safety-note routing.
The mitigation artifact is only a draft runbook and is missing required approval-grade elements because the accountable owner and alert threshold are still marked TBD.

Policy text states certification without material caveats requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion; the available evidence does not show that predicate is satisfied.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved slice issue unless that issue is determined immaterial or is disclosed/accepted.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that the current packet supports caveat-free certification.
Any claim that draft monitoring and public governance guidance remove the current disclosure requirement.
Any implied claim that an approved mitigation or approved risk acceptance already exists.
